Concurrent transaction cache API for forked blockhash and txnhash insert and query.

# Purpose
This header declares the public interface for a transaction cache used by the runtime to track executed transactions by message hash. The cache supports concurrent lockless `insert` and `query` operations, while rare management operations such as `reset`, `attach_child`, `advance_root`, and `finalize_fork` take a write lock on the full structure. It also defines the memory layout helpers [`fd_txncache_align`](<#fd_txncache_align>) and [`fd_txncache_footprint`](<#fd_txncache_footprint>), plus the creation and join functions [`fd_txncache_new`](<#fd_txncache_new>) and [`fd_txncache_join`](<#fd_txncache_join>) for shared-memory use. The comments describe the fork and blockhash model used to prevent duplicate execution across leader and replay paths, and note that nonce transactions are excluded from the cache.
